data.name: Livvy
data.gender_notes: Livvy is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'livos', meaning 'live'. This name symbolizes vitality, energy, and zest for life. In Christianity, it is associated with the spirit of revival and new beginnings. The name Livvy carries the meaning “Live, vivacious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Livvy usually hope their child will grow to embody live, vivacious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Livvy total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Livvy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Livvy is derived from the Old English word 'lief', which means 'dear' or 'beloved'. The suffix '-vy' is added to create a diminutive form, making the name meaning 'lively' or 'bright'. Another possible origin is from the Old English word 'gife', which means 'giver'. In this case, the name Livvy would mean 'lively giver'.
